instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion" with the input in the worked example.

2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion) and works through its steps in order: write-the-business-facts, name-the-life-areas, set-the-daily-minimum, set-the-contact-rules, carry-results-outward, make-the-checklist, check-tools-live, run-accounts, run-social-posting, run-replies, run-short-videos, run-articles, run-search-engines, record-search-engines, gather-buyer-words, run-landing-page, run-price-tests, record-price-tests, run-funnel-and-baseline, run-brand-and-emails, run-payments, run-paid-access, record-paid-access, run-course, run-community, run-member-billing, run-onboarding, run-retention-and-referral, run-legal-and-support, run-payment-recovery, run-launch-proof, close-the-gaps, record-the-buyer-fit-gap, read-the-checklist.
3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is read-the-checklist.

worked_examples.title: Set up a business to run entirely on Trillion from its first step

input.business_name: <business_name: The business's public name, in the person's words>
input.owner_name: <owner_name: The person who owns the business and approves its posts>
input.owner_email: <owner_email: The owner's own email address, used for tests>
input.first_offer_name: <first_offer_name: The first thing the business sells>
input.first_offer_price_text: <first_offer_price_text: The first offer's price in the person's words, for example '$49 once'>
input.posts_per_day: <posts_per_day: How many posts a day, from 1 to 5>
input.currency: <currency: Three-letter currency code, for example USD>

worked_examples.hands_back: Step write-the-business-facts answers with facts_written, fields_missing.
worked_examples.given: The person gives: business_name, owner_name, owner_email, first_offer_name, first_offer_price_text, posts_per_day, currency (shown as <name> in the input).

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
